system: FlashFloodAI Government-Aligned Flood Threshold & Risk Label Engine
standards_authority: Central Water Commission (CWC), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India

NORMAL.description: River stage below official CWC warning level. River within normal monsoonal channel capacity.

ABOVE_NORMAL.description: River stage has reached or exceeded official warning level. Low-lying riparian floodplains on notice.

SEVERE.description: River stage has breached official danger level. Embankment overtopping, structural inundation active.

EXTREME.description: River stage has exceeded historical all-time Highest Flood Level (HFL). Catastrophic inundation.

DATA_UNAVAILABLE.description: Live gauge telemetry offline (HTTP 503 / sensor maintenance). Missing values preserved as null.

gauge_datum_msl_m.description: Station zero gauge datum elevation above MSL

hfl_m.description: Official CWC Highest Flood Level (all-time peak)

water_level_m.description: Current observed water level above MSL

warning_exceedance_m.description: Water level exceedance above warning level

danger_exceedance_m.description: Water level exceedance above danger level

warning_ratio.description: Ratio of water level to warning level

danger_ratio.description: Ratio of water level to danger level

hfl_ratio.description: Ratio of water level to HFL
